name: web_search
label: Web Search
description: Search the web using Brave Search or Perplexity Sonar. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets for research and fact-checking.

search_lang.description: ISO language code for search results (e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr')

ui_lang.description: ISO language code for UI elements

freshness.description: Filter by discovery time (Brave only). Values: 'pd' (past 24h), 'pw' (past week), 'pm' (past month), 'py' (past year), or 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD'
